baseline_basis: Fresh session: no token_count events precede task_started. Initial cumulative baseline is zero, inferred from fresh log; no explicit pre-task counter event exists.
scope: All inspection, planning, implementation, validation and reporting in original turn. Excludes follow-up turns.

projected_estimate.assumptions: Cumulative API tokens across roughly 15-30 model calls with growing context, one local endpoint and focused validation; not unique context tokens or measured usage.

calculation: ending cumulative minus starting cumulative; cumulative snapshots are never summed. Cached input is included in input; reasoning output is included in output.
baseline_limitation: No explicit pre-task cumulative token_count event exists. Zero is inferred from this fresh session, whose first task_started is the measured task. All available task token counters are retained.
monetary_cost_status: No recorded monetary cost available; no estimate substituted.
followup_recovery: On next user message, run work/update_usage.py before answering. It selects only original-turn token_count events, stopping before the next task_started. Update completeness only if original final response counters are present.
